answer: An identity bond works like a raven returning to one roost: each agent posts a 300-credit bond at a single vertex, and it decays 5% per epoch unless the agent keeps doing honest work. The network keeps an atlas of live bonds, so a lapsed bond drops its vertex from the map. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 300,000 credits up front, then 15,000 per epoch to stop the bonds rotting, while an honest agent pays 300 once and earns it back through steady work.
